fieldValues.title: Declare RFC-038's srs-integration manifest, retire the #297 grandfather
fieldValues.summary: RFC-038's stub record (rfc-4071ab22.json) sat grandfathered in rfcs/integration-allowlist.json since #591 repointed it off dead #297. Declared the manifest: 5 schema: tokens (verified against current docs/schema/2.0/, not the stale relations-collection.json the issue named -- srs#527 already retired that file), 9 I-<n> invariant tokens, 5 mechanism: tokens, and tooling-only for the enumeration script. Cross-RFC amendment claims (RFC-039/026/013/017) resolved via existing tokens where a fold already exists and documented in-manifest otherwise; RFC-026 [R5]/[R6]/[R13] is a genuine unfolded gap, filed separately as #766 rather than patched here (Door 3, not Door 1). Removed the allowlist grandfather entry and re-rendered docs/spec/rfcs/rfc-catalog.md.
fieldValues.body: PR: https://github.com/the-greenman/srs/pull/768. Proved the guard: with the allowlist entry removed and the manifest reverted, check-rfc-integration.mjs fails with 'no integration manifest'; reapplying the manifest returns it to green. Both validate-all.mjs and check-release-drift.mjs pass by exit code on the final diff.
